temporal_split.cutoff_basis: 75th and 87.5th percentiles of all rating-event timestamps, snapped so the complete cutoff timestamp block remains in the later split
temporal_split.boundary_timestamp_policy: the complete timestamp block is assigned to the later split
temporal_split.target_policy: lowest movie_id among relevant ratings in the user's first timestamp block in the stage window

cohorts.warm: at least 5 relevant interactions before the stage cutoff
cohorts.cold: zero observed rating events before the stage cutoff
cohorts.primary_population: union of declared warm and cold users with a relevant target in their first stage-window timestamp block
cohorts.excluded: users with prior history that does not satisfy the warm rule

prepared_splits.test_access_control: process-enforced by committed hashes and an access ledger; not a cryptographic access-control boundary

candidates.seen_exclusion: every rating event observed before the stage cutoff, independent of relevance

evaluation.warm_item_rule: at least one relevant interaction in the stage fitting matrix
evaluation.cold_user_fallback: global item popularity; no randomly initialized user embedding is scored
evaluation.catalog_coverage_uncertainty: full-cohort descriptive estimate only because unique-item coverage is a non-additive set statistic

bootstrap.eligible_metrics: user-additive Recall, NDCG, MRR, and user coverage only

selection.candidate_scope: one predeclared representative configuration per model family; no hyperparameter sweep or optimized-family claim
selection.rule: maximum ndcg_at_10 over the full declared population; ties resolved by declared model order
selection.test_acceptance_gate: selected model paired ndcg_at_10 confidence interval lower bound versus the frozen strongest simple baseline is greater than zero
